title: Indonesia and Thailand cumulative revenue-loss probabilities compared

claims.text: Thailand shows a higher cumulative probability of revenue loss than Indonesia, though the gap between the two is modest; this is an association under the conditional model, not a causal ranking.

limitations: Cumulative probabilities are conditional on the ENSO event scenario and fiscal transmission assumptions; they are not sovereign default probabilities.
Historical input provenance is incomplete; this assessment is for inspection only and is not recomputable.
The measure reflects agriculture, forestry and fishing value added plus conditional government revenue transmission, not total-economy loss.
Price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled; results are in constant 2025 USD at a fixed 2025 exchange rate.
Country-level probabilities are marginal to each country and cannot be summed or combined across countries.
